Hyderabad Woman Alleges Abuse and Forced Labor in Oman

A woman from Hyderabad has alleged severe abuse, including forced labor and denial of pay, after being lured to Oman for a housemaid job. She reportedly sent a video detailing her ordeal to a politician in Hyderabad, appealing for rescue. The allegations include working long hours and facing physical mistreatment.
